decisions.decision: Keep normal FTB party semantics. Only crafting player A receives personal crafting advancement; A/B in same party share FTB task completion; separate-team B remains incomplete. Do not silently impose a new personal FTB system or claim every same-team member crafted.
decisions.basis: Independent reviewer actual FTB common-source review; coordinator has not independently reread those in-memory source bodies.

decisions.decision: Name future receipt as native crafting-action history, not post-payment/crash-atomic settlement. Forge ResultSlot posts event before remaining-ingredient deduction. Future listener must not consume materials again; ordinary take/shift-click/full-inventory/payment must be checked only after implementation.
decisions.basis: Coordinator direct native ResultSlot source read confirms exact ordering.

decisions.decision: Match functional current traits and exact output item/function tags; display name is not identity. Historical crafting completion remains after later trait removal; do not turn history objective into current equipment check.

Use craft-only task meaning for four proposed branches. Do not infer workbench crafting from source-material discovery, pickup, table first_infusion, purchase, cloud owner or poison kills. Preserve old broad marching-wine history. Merchant onCraftedBy is distinct from Forge crafted event.
decisions.basis: Coordinator direct MerchantResultSlot source read confirms callback distinction; deeper smoke/table findings remain attributed independent review.

decisions.decision: Default new rewards empty/nonrepeatable. Authoritative generator must carry stable dedicated IDs and variant-aware recipe navigation after own1000 gate. Do not modify only rendered SNBT, or reset old IDs/rewards.

future_acceptance_reference: Use independent future_acceptance_matrix; all entries NOT_RUN, no new native credit. Follow-up delegated for before-prerequisite crafting and party/reload lifecycle.
